Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `fs/nfs/nfs4xdr.c`**
- A new variable `replen` of type `uint32_t` is introduced to hold the adjusted reply length.
- The calculation of `replen` is updated to include the maximum size of the operation decode header (`op_decode_hdr_maxsz`).
- The comment regarding the setup of the reply kvec is modified to clarify that the `device_addr4` opaque data is now read into the pages.
- The call to `rpc_prepare_reply_pages` is updated to use the new `replen` value, which now accounts for additional padding (specifically, it adds 2 for the notification bitmap and 1 for alignment).

### Relationships Between Modifications
The modifications in `fs/nfs/nfs4xdr.c` are directly related to fixing the alignment of page data in the `getdeviceinfo` reply. By adjusting the calculation of the reply length (`replen`), the patch ensures that the opaque data padding for `device_addr4` fits correctly within the allocated pages. This change addresses the issue introduced by a previous commit (identified by the fix reference) that likely caused misalignment or improper handling of the reply data structure.

 static void nfs4_xdr_enc_getdeviceinfo(struct rpc_rqst *req,
 				       struct xdr_stream *xdr,
 				       const void *data)
 {
 	const struct nfs4_getdeviceinfo_args *args = data;
 	struct compound_hdr hdr = {
 		.minorversion = nfs4_xdr_minorversion(&args->seq_args),
 	};
+	uint32_t replen;
 
 	encode_compound_hdr(xdr, req, &hdr);
 	encode_sequence(xdr, &args->seq_args, &hdr);
+
+	replen = hdr.replen + op_decode_hdr_maxsz;
+
 	encode_getdeviceinfo(xdr, args, &hdr);
 
-	/* set up reply kvec. Subtract notification bitmap max size (2)
-	 * so that notification bitmap is put in xdr_buf tail */
+	/* set up reply kvec. device_addr4 opaque data is read into the
+	 * pages */
 	rpc_prepare_reply_pages(req, args->pdev->pages, args->pdev->pgbase,
-				args->pdev->pglen, hdr.replen - 2);
+				args->pdev->pglen, replen + 2 + 1);
 	encode_nops(&hdr);
 }
